header.title: Build a resume step by step
header.sub: Answer a few short questions. You can skip any step marked optional and change everything later in the editor.

resumeBuilder.loadError: We couldn't load the builder. Check your connection and try again.

basics.title: Contact details
basics.hint: Your name and how employers can reach you.

intent.title: The job you want
intent.hint: The job title you're aiming for. It goes at the top of your resume.

summary.title: Summary
summary.hint: Two or three sentences about what you do and what you're looking for.

education.title: Education
education.hint: Schools, degrees and dates. Add your grades only if you want them on the page.

projects.title: Projects
projects.hint: Class, personal or work projects that show what you can do.

campus.title: Campus activities
campus.hint: Clubs, student groups, volunteering and leadership roles.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Tools, languages and other skills you'd be glad to be asked about.

certificates.title: Certificates and skills
certificates.hint: Certificates, language tests and licenses. Add your score if you'd like it shown.

awards.title: Awards
awards.hint: Scholarships, prizes and competitions, one per line.

selfEvaluation.title: About me
selfEvaluation.hint: A short paragraph about your strengths, written in your own words.

autobiography.title: Personal statement
autobiography.hint: Your background, what shaped you and why you want this kind of job.

personal.title: Photo and personal details
personal.hint: All optional. Leave anything blank that you'd rather not share.

review.title: Review
review.hint: Check each step, then create your resume. It opens in the editor.

docLanguage.label: Resume language
docLanguage.hint: The language your resume is written in. You can download it with section titles in another language later.

field.linksHint: LinkedIn, portfolio or GitHub. Separate them with commas.
field.salaryAmountHint: Write it the way you'd say it, for example a monthly range.
field.endHint: Leave blank if you're still there.
field.title: Job title
field.notesHint: Plain notes are fine: what you worked on, how, and what came of it. Only what you write here can be used.

star.situationHint: What was the setting or the problem?
star.actionHint: What did you do, step by step?
star.resultHint: What changed because of your work? Use real numbers only if you have them.

field.certificatesHint: Tap one to add it, then add your score if you'd like it shown.
field.awardsHint: One per line, with the year.
field.summaryHint: Keep it short. Say what you do, what you're good at and what you're looking for.
field.selfEvaluationHint: Three or four sentences. Give an example for each strength you mention.
field.autobiographyHint: A few paragraphs: your background, what you've learned and why this kind of job.

prompts.bullets: Start each bullet point with what you did, then how, then what came of it. Use numbers only when they're real.
prompts.star: Describe each project in four short parts: the situation, your task, what you did and the result.

ai.off: Writing help is off for your account, so nothing here is sent to an AI model. You can write every part yourself.
ai.suggestBullets: Suggest bullet points from my notes
ai.notesFirst: Write a few notes first. Suggestions only use what you write.
ai.note: Written by AI from your notes. Read each one and add it only if it's true.
ai.blocked: {count, plural, one {# suggestion was left out because it added a number you didn't write.} other {# suggestions were left out because they added numbers you didn't write.}}

errors.unavailable: Writing help isn't available right now. You can keep writing on your own.
errors.credits: You've used all your rewrites for now. You can keep writing on your own.
errors.blocked: We couldn't use that text. Try rewording your notes.
errors.citationGuard: Every suggestion added numbers that aren't in your notes, so none are shown. No rewrite was used.
errors.noSuggestion: No suggestion came back. No rewrite was used. Try again or add more detail to your notes.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. No rewrite was used. Try again.

personal.intro: These details are optional. They're printed on the downloaded file only. They're never sent to an AI model or used to rank you for jobs.

photo.label: Add my photo to the downloaded file
photo.hint: Your photo stays in this browser. It's added when you download and is never saved on our servers.

errors.unsupported: Use a JPEG or PNG photo.
errors.tooLarge: That photo is too large. Try a smaller one.

review.after: Your resume opens in the editor next. You can change the wording, the order of sections and the layout there.

errors.name_required: Add your full name to continue.
errors.title_required: Add the job title you want to continue.
errors.limit: You already have {limit} resumes. Delete one to add another.
errors.generic: We couldn't create your resume. Your answers are still here. Try again.

fit.fitted: {pages, plural, one {Now fits on # page.} other {Now fits on # pages.}} Only spacing, margins and text size changed.
fit.already: {pages, plural, one {Already fits on # page.} other {Already fits on # pages.}} Nothing changed.
fit.tooLong: {target, plural, one {Too long to fit on # page without removing text.} other {Too long to fit on # pages without removing text.}} Nothing changed. Try shortening a few bullet points.
fit.undone: Spacing, margins and text size are back to how they were.
fit.error: We couldn't fit the resume. Nothing changed. Try again.

assistant.ask: Ask the Assistant about this resume
assistant.prompt: I'm editing my resume. Help me improve it.

order.hint: Move sections up or down. The text inside doesn't change.
order.tooFew: Add another section to change the order.

campus.name: Campus
campus.desc: A4, one or two pages, education first. Made for students and recent graduates.

layout.justify: Line up text on both sides

headingLanguage.label: Section titles in the downloaded file
headingLanguage.hint: Changes the section titles only. Your own text stays as you wrote it.

grade.title: Your grade
grade.body: This is how your resume did on our checklist. It isn't a prediction of whether you'll get an interview.

filters.title: Issues by priority
filters.body: Start with the issues to fix first. Tap a group to see only those issues.

issues.title: Fix an issue
issues.body: Each issue says what we found and why it matters. Open it to see how to fix it, then make the change in the editor.

recheck.title: Check again
recheck.body: After you edit, check again. We'll show what changed since the last check.
